title: Maximum Number of Words You Can Type
description:
[Source: LeetCode 1935]
There is a malfunctioning keyboard where some letter keys do not work. Given a string text of words separated by a single space and a string brokenLetters of all distinct letter keys that are broken, return the number of words in text you can fully type.

Input Format:
First line: text
Second line: brokenLetters

Output Format:
Typeable words count
